sources: Global adult (15+) literacy rate, 1820–2016: Our World in Data based on OECD (2014) 'How Was Life? Global Well-being since 1820' (1820–1940), UNESCO (1950–1970) and World Bank/UNESCO (later), owid-datasets 'Global literacy since 1800 (OWID based on OECD & UNESCO (2019))'. 1820: 12.0 %, 1900: 21.4 %, 1950: 56 %, 2016: 86.2 %.
Historical values are estimates; 'literate' definitions differ between sources and years.
Still unable to read: about 754 million adults (UNESCO Institute for Statistics, International Literacy Day 2024).
